guidance.statement: Tanishq new store additions target remains at 35 to 40 for the year barring some execution, and 70 to 80 for renovations.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target. And overall, for the renovations, etcetera, 70 to 80 may be the orders that may happen for the year.

guidance.statement: Watches business margins will gradually revert towards 16%, 17% band, with mid-teen (15% to 16%) as a good number to aim for in 1 to 2 years.
guidance.quote: they will gradually revert towards 16%, 17% band. And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

guidance.statement: Eyecare growth outlook is expected to close the year anywhere between 13% to 14%.
guidance.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
